t: 格姆布卢克之战(德语:Battle of Gembloux)是奥地利的唐·约翰所领导的西班牙军…
te: The Battle of Gembloux is a victory for Spanish forces led by Don John of Austria over a rebel army of Dutch, Flemish, …
dz: 八十年战争和盎格鲁-西班牙战争:格姆布卢克之战(德语:Battle of Gembloux)是奥地利的唐·约翰所领导的西班牙军队战胜了一支由荷兰人,弗拉芒人,英国人,苏格兰人,德意志人,法国人和瓦隆人组成的叛乱军队.
de: Eighty Years' War and Anglo-Spanish War: The Battle of Gembloux is a victory for Spanish forces led by Don John of Austria over a rebel army of Dutch, Flemish, English, Scottish, German, French and Walloons.

t: 亨利三世国王所铺设的第一块石碑为"新桥"(Pont Neuf (New Bridge)),是法…
te: King Henry III lays the first stone of the Pont Neuf (New Bridge), the oldest bridge of Paris, France.
dz: 亨利三世国王所铺设的第一块石碑为"新桥"(Pont Neuf (New Bridge)),是法国巴黎最古老的桥梁.
de: King Henry III lays the first stone of the Pont Neuf (New Bridge), the oldest bridge of Paris, France.

t: 摩洛哥人击败了葡萄牙人,但摩洛哥国王Abd al-Malik和葡萄牙国王Sebastian都战…
te: The Moroccans defeat the Portuguese but both the Moroccan king Abd al-Malik and the Portuguese king Sebastian die. Ahma…
dz: Al Kasr al Kebir战役:摩洛哥人击败了葡萄牙人,但摩洛哥国王Abd al-Malik和葡萄牙国王Sebastian都战死. Ahmad al-Mansur追随Abd al-Malik出任摩洛哥苏丹,而Sebastian之死导致葡萄牙接班危机.
de: Battle of Al Kasr al Kebir: The Moroccans defeat the Portuguese but both the Moroccan king Abd al-Malik and the Portuguese king Sebastian die. Ahmad al-Mansur follows Abd al-Malik as sultan of Morocco while the death of Sebastian leads to a succession crisis in Portugal.
